newsitem.title: USA: Credit Lyonnais says Parretti claims axed.
newsitem.headline: Credit Lyonnais says Parretti claims axed.

text.p: Credit Lyonnais SA said on Monday that the California Superior Court in Los Angeles had rejected the claims of Giancarlo Parretti against the bank and its former Dutch subsidiary, Credit Lyonnais Bank Nederland.

The lawsuit, filed in March 1994, claimed damages of $3.9 billion, accusing Credit Lyonnais and its Dutch unit of misrepresentation and other alleged business improprieties in connection with the 1990 acquisition of hollywood studio MGM/UA by Parretti's former company, Pathe Communications Corp.
The bank said that the ruling leaves in place the June 9 trial date on Credit Lyonnais Bank Nederland's claim against Parretti of "fraudulently inducing" bank financing for the MGM acquisition.
